_comment: Owner-confirmed store facts (2026-11-19; location updated 2026-11-20). Loaded as approved knowledge. Add only facts the owner has confirmed.

documents.question: What are your hours? When are you open?
documents.answer: We're open every day from 4:30 AM to 12:30 PM, including holidays.

documents.question: Are you open on holidays like Christmas, Thanksgiving or New Year's?
documents.answer: Yes. We're open every day of the year, holidays included, from 4:30 AM to 12:30 PM.

documents.question: Where are you located? What is your address? Which Town Donut store is this? Directions?
documents.answer: We're Town Donut Watson, in the Oak Point Plaza next to Subway: 35505 LA-16 #3C, Denham Springs, LA 70706. Map: https://www.google.com/maps/dir//35505+LA-16+%233C,+Denham+Springs,+LA+70706/data=!4m6!4m5!1m1!4e2!1m2!1m1!1s0x8626944e98ea8175:0x69c5739ea3fecf53 . Messenger orders are picked up at this store only.

documents.question: What is your phone number? How do I call the store?
documents.answer: You can call the store at (225) 380-5250.

documents.question: How do I pay? Can I pay online or with a card here?
documents.answer: Payment is made at pickup. We never take card details over Messenger.

documents.question: Do prices include tax?
documents.answer: Menu prices are before tax. Tax is added at pickup.

documents.question: Do you deliver? How do Messenger orders work?
documents.answer: Orders placed here on Messenger are for pickup at the store. You confirm your order, then our team accepts it and you pay at pickup.

documents.question: Do you make custom or decorated donuts for birthdays, holidays or events?
documents.answer: Yes! Our Special Design Donut is $22.89 before tax. It can say things like "Happy Birthday", "Happy Bday {Name}" or "Merry Christmas". Names longer than 7 letters have an extra charge that our team confirms. Tell us the message and the design you'd like (theme, colors, decorations). Please order by the day before pickup: it doesn't have to be a full 24 hours, so ordering today for tomorrow morning is fine, but we can't make them for the same day.
